'''Atgar SpaceDefense Corporation''', known as '''Atgar''', was the manufacturer of anti-vehicle weaponry and defense systems. Many of Atgar's products, such as the [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Tower]], emphasized power over efficiency. Due to their low cost and obsoleteness, they were often found deployed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="GG3" /> but the weapons were generally low-powered and not as powerful as the weapons in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

Atgar was known to use the [[FD number]] system to categorize its military units. Despite being a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] defense corporation, a certain number of Atgar's [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] were fitted on [[GX12 Hovervan]]s.
